regions.today: There will be sunny spells and some well scattered showers this evening, in moderate southwesterly winds.
regions.tonight: Staying mostly dry tonight with clear spells and just isolated showers. Lowest temperatures of 11 to 14 degrees in moderate southwesterly winds.
